firstPlayerRule: Choose the starting player randomly and give them the First-player and Active-player tokens. They choose the first action; the Active-player token passes clockwise.
clarifications: Everyone may take the other-player benefit of the chosen action, but one active player chooses which action is taken.
internalEvidence: Current Inside Up Earth product links public Drive rulebook collection. Followed Earth folder to single-page English manual.
